_comment: Two epochs of R7 (--protocol kfold --fold 0 --model gnn --mask-blocks 0.15 --seed 0 --tag eqcheck --epochs 2) as the 3-block-level-counting branch (3764cc7, python -m training.train) trains it, with torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True) and CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 (CUDA index_add_ and scatter_reduce are otherwise not reproducible from run to run: two undeterministic runs of the branch differ in the first epoch loss by 0.16).
